# ontograph-cli
> An entity-relationship knowledge graph CLI for adding entities, relating them, and querying the graph.
Canonical project page: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/ontograph-cli/
GitHub: https://github.com/imba97/ontograph-cli
Status: documented candidate
Last verified: 2026-11-17
